business_problem: Operating globally, the company faces a complex cost structure due to different business systems for each affiliation. The company is focusing on reducing costs and optimizing operations.
solution_summary: Mitsubishi Chemical Group built this solution on Power Apps, Microsoft Teams. Operating globally, the company faces a complex cost structure due to different business systems for each affiliation. The company is focusing on reducing costs and optimizing operations. Power Apps delivers low-code business applications used by employees in the new process. Microsoft Teams presents collaboration workflows and shared communication experiences to end users. The company has created a platform for centralized access to apps and content via Microsoft Teams. The company is also promoting the visualization of work styles and citizen development projects. Business requests and operational data enter Power Apps and Power Automate workflows, which route approvals, invoke automation or AI where needed, and return results through governed low-code applications.

metrics: Project 1: Visualizing Work Styles to Increase Employee Engagement
Since July 2023, when we decided to introduce the system, Microsoft Japan has formed a dedicated team for our company and have been holding weekly one-hour long meetings.
Power Platform was available with Microsoft 365 licenses up to that point, but we felt that it was too early to use it as the foundation for our applications.

This system, which would have cost 200 million yen to implement with the interlocks and therefore considered to be not cost-effective, was actually produced for about 1 million yen and this quickly yielded results.
